_doc: Category taxonomy for entity-category-mismatch detector. Agent-maintained: any user (human or LLM) extending vouch's comprehensiveness coverage for a new domain should add categories here, not in source. Each top-level key is a canonical category; the value is a list of synonyms (single-word or multi-word, lowercase). Detection: an entity is tagged with category C iff a predicate phrase near the entity contains any synonym for C. Mismatch fires when proposition and KB claim tag the same entity with disjoint category sets. Update via bench/dogfood/discover_taxonomy.ts.
_provenance: Seeded from cross-validation findings on fires-judge-study-P_alpha (2026-05-14): FActScore, follic, Letta, mem0. Domain at seed time: AI/ML benchmark discussion. Expand for other domains.
